sentences.en: Happiness shared returns many-fold, sadness shared comes back halved.
sentences.zh: 快乐分享则会倍增，悲伤分享则会减半。

sentences.en: The Mediterranean diet halves the risk of heart disease.
sentences.zh: 地中海饮食可以将心脏病的风险减半。

sentences.en: At last Souichiro and Yukino decided to cut the orange into halves.
sentences.zh: 最后，寿一和叶乃决定把橙子切成两半。

senses.zh: 把…分成两半,把…减半,对分,平摊
